dedupe_keys.name: bittimittari fi open data crowdsourced broadband quality measurements finland

description: Bittimittari.fi is Traficom's service for users to measure the quality of their broadband connection with an app or a browser, and Traficom publishes the results as open data. The dataset includes only measurements in which the speed tests and the latency test succeeded. The current calendar month is updated once a day, while area information such as the municipality number follows with a delay of a few days; monthly datasets are available for three years back, and older data are not revised afterwards, for example after municipal mergers. Measurements record download and upload speed and latency with information on the connection and area, which allows achieved quality to be compared between municipalities, operators and access types. Coverage: Finland, wherever users run tests. Format and access: open data files linked from Traficom's open data page, free under Traficom's open data terms (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 for its published data). Caveats: crowdsourced tests reflect who chooses to test; successful tests only, so failed connections are not captured. Simulation uses: baselines of achieved speeds and latency by municipality, and detection of degradation during storms or outages. Related records: ČTÚ-NetTest, RTR-NetTest and Breitbandmessung are neighbouring crowdsourced tools, and the Traficom communications open data record lists the regulator's other datasets.
